label: early original-phase input of k/z/3/h/r/m
explanation: Fires only in the original (input) phase, essentially never at the delimiter or during copy, and never at t=0. Rate peaks at t=2-3 (about 19%) and falls to near zero by t>=6. Within that window it prefers inputs k, z, 3 (rate 20-23%), then h, r, m (13-16%), with weaker response to l, 2, b, e. It is stronger on the first occurrence of a token (in_first=1 holds 85% of mass). The strongest activations come from runs of these preferred tokens early in the sequence (e.g. o k z k k, z z k, o 3 z z z). Prior preferred tokens raise activation on later steps, so it also fires weakly on non-preferred tokens that follow them (e.g. m x: x active). In-phase t=1..5 alone gets recall 0.99 but precision 0.14. Adding the token set gives dev F1 0.56 with mass recall 0.77. Precision tops out around 0.5-0.6 because the response looks graded and cumulative rather than a clean boolean.
